import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

new_parent_task = aos_manager.create_task(
    tick=213,
    description="Project Metis Phase 6: Collaborative Analysis of Transgenerational Data",
    parent_id=None
)

aos_manager.create_task(
    tick=213,
    description="Gather and consolidate all ancestral strategy and performance data from Progressor I's G1-G10 experiments.",
    parent_id=new_parent_task['id']
)
